related.title: AI 加速器巨作總驗收：學徒導師的有效服務量
related.titleEn: AI-accelerator capstone: useful service for an apprentice mentor
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：缺失毀損均能續傳，順序錯誤被全檔校驗攔下，無權重自動公開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Missing/corrupt chunks resume, whole-file hashes catch ordering faults, and weights are not automatically public.
related.difference: 將正確、具來源且準時的回答計為有效服務，避免只以生成token速度排名。
related.differenceEn: Count correct, sourced, on-time answers as useful service rather than ranking by token speed alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定分塊傳輸只重送缺少或校驗失敗的塊；完整檔雜湊需在重組後再次核對。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學模型8192 MiB，塊64 MiB，共128塊，連線有效速率32 MiB/s，忽略協定開銷。 全量理想時間8192/32=256 s；雜湊計算及伺服器確認另計。
goodput=同時通過所有要求的請求數/時間；不能把各條件通過率直接相乘，除非有獨立性證據。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 60 s內完成120題，其中逐題核對後90題同時符合來源、工程答案與5 s期限。 原始完成率120/60=2題/s；有效服務90/60=1.5題/s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Fixed-chunk resume retransmits missing/corrupt chunks; the reconstructed whole-file digest is checked again. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching model8192 MiB, 64 MiB chunks, 128 chunks, effective32 MiB/s, excluding protocol overhead. Full ideal transfer256 s, with hashing and server confirmation additional.

Goodput=jointly passing requests/time; do not multiply marginal pass rates without independence evidence. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. In60 s, 120 questions complete; per-request audit finds90 jointly meet source, engineering-answer and 5 s deadline criteria. Raw throughput2 questions/s; goodput1.5 questions/s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: EfficientNet：深寬解析度聯合縮放
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：缺失毀損均能續傳，順序錯誤被全檔校驗攔下，無權重自動公開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Missing/corrupt chunks resume, whole-file hashes catch ordering faults, and weights are not automatically public.
related.difference: 列基準與新模型每層H,W,C及重複次數；先保留連續倍率，再單獨記錄整數取整。；報告包含1.92027與1.452，並明列近似成本不等於端到端延遲。
related.differenceEn: List H,W,C and repeats for baseline and scaled layers; keep continuous scaling separate from integer rounding.; Report1.92027 and1.452 and explicitly distinguish approximate cost from end-to-end latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定分塊傳輸只重送缺少或校驗失敗的塊；完整檔雜湊需在重組後再次核對。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學模型8192 MiB，塊64 MiB，共128塊，連線有效速率32 MiB/s，忽略協定開銷。 全量理想時間8192/32=256 s；雜湊計算及伺服器確認另計。
卷積主導近似成本倍率為d×w²×r²；忽略取整、固定層與記憶體瓶頸。；教學相對倍率d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15；只改r至1.0作對照。；倍率=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027；r=1時1.452。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Fixed-chunk resume retransmits missing/corrupt chunks; the reconstructed whole-file digest is checked again. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching model8192 MiB, 64 MiB chunks, 128 chunks, effective32 MiB/s, excluding protocol overhead. Full ideal transfer256 s, with hashing and server confirmation additional.

A convolution-dominated cost scales approximately as d×w²×r², ignoring rounding, fixed layers and memory bottlenecks.; Teaching factors d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15; compare r=1.0 with other factors fixed.; Multiplier=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027; r=1 gives1.452.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
